summary: Project-local validation overrides for the active ZOTERO-DOM-CONTRACT-WAVE-001 advisory DOM contract batch, the completed ZOTERO-HOST-POLISH-WAVE-001 host-visible polish baseline, and the completed OPTIONAL-BUNDLE-WAVE-001 optional bundle baseline.

overrides.summary: DOM contract hardening on the existing preference pane, item pane, and reader surfaces stays advisory-first: keep the real host actions and route-aware DOM checks visible in E2E / monitor / dashboard / gate output, but do not turn route-level DOM contract failures into a new v1 blocker.
requiredChecks: 继续通过 `npm run check`、`npm run agent:zotero:e2e`、`npm run agent:monitor` 与 `npm run agent:gate` 完成真实宿主闭环。
对 `preference pane / item pane / reader` 输出 route-aware DOM contract 摘要，让测试后能直接读到结构化操作日志，不依赖 Error Console。
DOM contract route 失败在 v1 只记 advisory；除非既有 surface smoke、visual evidence、runtime guard 或 gate 合同失败，否则不单独抬成 blocker。
nonGoals: 把当前波次重新抬回 strict visual-required
扩展到 context pane、menu、child window、iframe、XUL custom element 或 virtualized table

overrides.summary: Host-visible polish work stays visual-required when it touches live interaction consistency, edge-attached geometry, or surface-local evidence on real Zotero surfaces, including collection menu and dynamic submenu verification.
requiredChecks: 完成 in-scope Host Actions 的 surface smoke，并输出逐项 readiness 结果。
涉及 collection menu 或 dynamic submenu 时，同时证明 live collection context、menuPath/child rebuild 与 surface-local evidence 已成立。
对贴边式 surface 同时证明 live geometry 已跟随宿主 bounds，或在过窄时返回显式 degrade 状态。
为成功的 host-visible surface 采集 surface-local evidence；整窗截图仅作为补充。
nonGoals: modal / destructive / 需要人工确认的入口自动化
只凭整窗截图判断 surface 正常

overrides.summary: Completed optional bundle baseline: keep the JS core green first, and only require bundle-local smoke when the default-disabled react-ui lane is explicitly enabled or its shell changes.
requiredChecks: 继续先通过 `npm run check` 的 JS-core 主链，不让 default-disabled bundle 破坏现有 build / verify / gate。
确认 `config/optional-bundles.json`、`build:react-ui` 与导出脚手架保持同轮同步。
当 `react-ui` 被启用，或其 window shell / surface bridge / host-mounted demo / host action 改动时，至少补一轮 bundle-local build smoke。
nonGoals: 在 bundle 默认禁用时把 React 依赖升级成主链强依赖
在 agent-runtime / ai-service 仍为 spec-only 时伪装为已实现
